```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("config_flow.R")

# ==============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# Edited directly for interactive use, or set via render_all.R params
# ==============================================================================

PARADIGM    <- params$paradigm   # "active" | "passive"
MEASURE     <- params$measure    # "raw" | "diff"
TRIALS      <- params$trials     # "correct" | "alltrials"
DATE_SOURCE <- NULL      # NULL = latest CSV; or pin a date, e.g. "20261031"

# ==============================================================================
# Auto-derived (do not edit)
# ==============================================================================

STUDY     <- if (PARADIGM == "active") "Active" else "Passive"
DATA_ROOT <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/flow/")
OUTPUT_RESULTS <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/flow/")

included_participants <- if (PARADIGM == "active") INCLUDED_ACTIVE else INCLUDED_PASSIVE

conditions_list <- switch(
  paste(PARADIGM, MEASURE, sep = "_"),
  active_raw   = CONDITIONS_ACTIVE_RAW,
  active_diff  = CONDITIONS_ACTIVE_DIFF,
  passive_raw  = CONDITIONS_PASSIVE_RAW,
  passive_diff = CONDITIONS_PASSIVE_DIFF
)

n        <- length(included_participants)
stim_col <- if (MEASURE == "diff") "contrast" else "stim"
DATE_STR <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

csv_path  <- find_stim_measures(DATA_ROOT, PARADIGM, "flow", MEASURE, TRIALS, DATE_SOURCE)
csv_fname <- basename(csv_path)

df_all <- load_cluster_data(csv_path, CONDITION_MAP, included_participants)

dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

cat(glue(

## Results

```{r analysis, results='asis'}
summary_rows <- list()
apa_texts    <- list()

for (cond in conditions_list) {
  component  <- cond$component
  stim       <- cond$stim
  window     <- cond$window
  cluster    <- cond$cluster
  electrodes <- CLUSTERS[[cluster]]
  label      <- glue("{component}_{stim}_{cluster}_{window}")

  df_cond <- filter_condition(df_all, stim_val = stim, window_val = window,
                              electrodes = electrodes)

  if (nrow(df_cond) == 0) {
    cat(glue("\n> Warning: No data for: {label}\n\n"))
    next
  }

  col_a <- paste0("mean_amp_uv.", CONDITION_LEVELS[1])
  col_b <- paste0("mean_amp_uv.", CONDITION_LEVELS[2])

  df_wide <- df_cond %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols      = participant,
      names_from   = condition,
      values_from  = mean_amp_uv,
      names_prefix = "mean_amp_uv.",
      values_fn    = mean
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("mean_amp_uv."), as.numeric))

  missing_cols <- setdiff(c(col_a, col_b), names(df_wide))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    cat(glue("\n> Warning: Missing condition(s) for {label}: {paste(missing_cols, collapse=', ')}\n\n"))
    next
  }

  df_wide <- df_wide %>% drop_na(all_of(c(col_a, col_b)))
  n_valid  <- nrow(df_wide)

  cat(glue("\n### {component} — {stim} | {window} | {cluster} cluster\n\n"))
  cat(glue("N = {n_valid} participants\n\n"))

  # Assumption check
  diffs   <- df_wide[[col_a]] - df_wide[[col_b]]
  shapiro <- shapiro.test(diffs)
  cat(glue("**Shapiro-Wilk** (differences): W = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$statistic), 3)}, p = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$p.value), 3)}\n\n"))

  results <- run_paired_ttest(df_wide, CONDITION_LEVELS)
  t_res   <- results$t
  d_res   <- results$d
  bf10    <- results$bf10
  bf01    <- results$bf01
  df_long <- results$df_long

  cat(glue("**Bayesian paired t-test**: BF10 = {format_bf(bf10)}, BF01 = {format_bf(bf01)}\n\n"))

  means <- c(mean(df_wide[[col_a]], na.rm = TRUE),
             mean(df_wide[[col_b]], na.rm = TRUE))
  sds   <- c(sd(df_wide[[col_a]], na.rm = TRUE),
             sd(df_wide[[col_b]], na.rm = TRUE))

  p <- plot_boxplot(df_long, CONDITION_LEVELS, CONDITION_COLORS,
                    component, stim, window, cluster)
  print(p)
  cat("\n")

  apa <- apa_ttest(t_res, d_res, bf10, component, stim, window, cluster,
                   CONDITION_LEVELS, means, sds)
  cat(glue("**APA:** {apa}\n\n"))
  apa_texts[[label]] <- apa

  summary_rows[[label]] <- build_summary_row(
    component, stim, window, cluster,
    CONDITION_LEVELS, means, sds, t_res, d_res, bf10, bf01
  )
}
```

## Summary Table

```{r summary-table}
summary_df <- bind_rows(summary_rows)
knitr::kable(
  summary_df,
  digits  = 3,
  caption = glue("FLOW | {toupper(PARADIGM)} | {toupper(MEASURE)}")
)
```

```{r save-summary}
out_fname <- glue("{OUTPUT_RESULTS}{PARADIGM}_flow_{MEASURE}_{TRIALS}_summary_{DATE_STR}.csv")
write.csv(summary_df, out_fname, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved summary ->", out_fname, "\n")
```
